title: Awesome tour!
text: Fantastic tour!  Turned into a private trip when the couple with us couldn't go.  Because we've done Segway tours before, our guide adjusted and took us on some steep and fun hills!  We learned a lot about Granada.  Got to tour a cave house and saw gorgeous views.  Definitely worth it.  Tour operator prioritizes safety.
author: Tracy_D

title: Alhambra Segway Tour Ralf.
text:
It was a super nice tour; our guide was excellent. Carmen showed us the sights beautifully and with heart, and she also responded to our wishes.

Great!

Thank you, Carmen.
author: Experience732510

title: Amazing Experience Fantastic Guide (Fares)
text: I can’t say enough. We had a private three hour tour. We asked to change the standard time to match our schedule and Victoria in the office was amazing. She went all out to make our wish come true. She was very receptive and coordinated everything for us. Then came the tour we had the best guide ever FARES was AMAAAAZZZING! He went out of his way to make us all safe, comfortable, entertained and educated (there was four of us 15-50y). He gave us a lot of history and insights into the city both old and new. I really can’t thank him or recommend them enough. Definitely one of my best Segway tour
author: UmSaifo

title: Amazing views of Granada
text: Excellent tour, great trip around the entire city including up the mountain for incredible views.
author: stuart m

title: Worth every penny!
text: Best part of this trip hands down! We got to see so much more than we ever could have walking, taking a cab, or taking a tour bus. Our guide was fantastic!
author: Anonymous

title: Kaell is a superb guide and a great guy
text:
Kaell was with us for the time we spent on the Segway 
He is an excellent guide, very friendly and personable where nothing was too much trouble.
I can strongly recommend using Kaell and we will definitely go with him again when we’re next in Granada
author: Richard T

title: 3 hours of segway and history.
text:
Highly recommended activity.
Thank you very much Borja! The stories and curiosities you have told us have made the adventure much more enjoyable.
We'll repeat!
author: xamauleon

title: Very good experience
text: We did the Granada tour with Borja and it was excellent! 10/10 the guide, explained everything and the operation of the bikes
author: M6312GHanav

title: Spectacular Tour
text: Fares was an incredible guide for a fun and enjoyable ride through Granada. He did an amazing job of making it interesting and safe. We saw so much more of the city than we would have on foot. Highly recommended!
author: Sarah_H

title: ONLY WAY TO SEE GRANADA
text: THE ONLY WAY TO SEE GRANADA….we were able to see and visit more than the typical visitor. Many people don’t realize how hilly Granada actually is and how physically demanding moving around all the neighborhoods can be. Nico was an amazing guide and teacher. We are both over 50 and Nico put us at ease with the Segway. At first it was intimidating but with a few minutes of teaching we were mastering the machine.
author: CABGdoc
